stops.title: Main Hall
stops.info: The double-height main hall, with the staircase and standing tables. The glass doors lead out to the courtyard.

stops.title: Enterprise Courtyard
stops.info: The open courtyard outside the hall, shaded by acacia trees. The Enterprise building ahead leads on to the brick walkway.

stops.title: Brick Walkway
stops.info: A brick path along the hillside that wraps around the building, with a view over the trees.
